description: This file defines a Rust struct `BufReader` that provides buffered reading capabilities for virtio input events, including methods for reading data, accessing the buffer, and consuming bytes.

classes.name: BufReader
classes.description: A buffered reader for virtio input events that manages an internal byte buffer and provides methods for reading and consuming data.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Creates a new instance of BufReader with an empty buffer.

methods.name: read_ahead
methods.description: Reads available bytes from the underlying reader into the buffer, handling full buffer and end-of-stream conditions.

methods.name: buffer
methods.description: Returns a slice of the currently available bytes in the buffer.

methods.name: consume
methods.description: Removes a specified number of bytes from the start of the buffer, shifting remaining data.
